question: Right of a prisoner to speedy trial will be categorized in which of the following Fundamental Rights?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Life**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The right to a speedy trial is derived from **Article 21** of the Indian Constitution, which guarantees the Right to Life and Personal Liberty.
 
• The Supreme Court of India has interpreted the **Right to Life** to include the right to a speedy trial as part of the broader concept of justice.
 
• This right ensures that no person is deprived of their liberty without due process and protects individuals from prolonged judicial delays.
 
• The landmark case **Hussainara Khatoon v. State of Bihar (1979)** established the principle that a speedy trial is an integral part of Article 21.
 
• The right to a speedy trial aims to prevent undue harassment and ensure fair justice for prisoners and accused individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 21 of the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• It states, "No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law."
 
• It is a fundamental right under Part III of the Constitution and is enforceable in courts.
 
 
 
• **Hussainara Khatoon Case (1979):**
 
 
• This case highlighted the plight of undertrial prisoners languishing in jails for extended periods due to judicial delays.
 
• The Supreme Court ruled that the right to a speedy trial is a fundamental right under Article 21.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Interpretation of Article 21:**
 
 
• The scope of Article 21 has been expanded over time to include rights like the right to privacy, the right to a clean environment, and the right to legal aid, among others.
 
• These interpretations aim to ensure that life and liberty are meaningful and not restricted to mere physical existence.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Speedy Trial:**
 
 
• Prevents unnecessary detention of undertrial prisoners.
 
• Ensures efficient administration of justice and prevents backlog in courts.
 
• Protects the dignity and mental well-being of accused individuals.
